parameters.jsCode: const xml = $input.first().json.data || $input.first().json.body || ''; const titleMatches = [...xml.matchAll(/<!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]><\/title>|<title>(.*?)<\/title>/g)].map(m => (m[1] || m[2] || '').replace(/&/g, '&').trim()).filter(Boolean).filter(t => !/daily search trends/i.test(t)); const trend = titleMatches[0] || 'AI automation for small business'; const serviceAngles = [ 'AI business automation', 'n8n workflow automation', 'ecommerce automation', 'web app development', 'AI chatbots and voice agents', 'SEO and GEO search strategy', 'data dashboards and BI', 'API integrations', 'cloud and cybersecurity', 'startup MVP launch' ]; const dayIndex = Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000) % serviceAngles.length; const angle = serviceAngles[dayIndex]; const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); const title = `${angle}: what ${trend} tells business owners in 2026`; const subtitle = `A daily JHD Advisor brief connecting today's search demand to practical automation, ecommerce, AI and web app execution.`; const slug = title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '').slice(0, 80); const content = `<section style="font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.75;color:#1f2937;"> <p><strong>Trending signal:</strong> ${trend}</p> <p>Search behavior changes fast. JHD Advisor turns those signals into practical business systems: automations that capture leads, ecommerce stores that sell, web apps that organize work, and AI agents that reduce manual follow-up.</p> <h2>Why this matters for ${angle}</h2> <p>When a trend starts moving, customers ask new questions. The businesses that win are the ones that publish helpful answers, connect those answers to offers, and automate the response path from page visit to CRM follow-up.</p> <h2>Recommended action plan</h2> <ol> <li>Create one focused landing page answering the trend-driven question.</li> <li>Add schema markup, internal links and a clear call to action.</li> <li>Connect the form to Odoo CRM, email, WhatsApp or your preferred sales workflow.</li> <li>Use AI to summarize inquiries, route leads and create follow-up drafts.</li> <li>Track conversion rate, response time and revenue per topic.</li> </ol> <h2>JHD Advisor services that fit</h2> <ul> <li>AI business automation and agent workflows</li> <li>n8n workflow automation</li> <li>Odoo, Shopify and WooCommerce ecommerce builds</li> <li>Web app and SaaS MVP development</li> <li>SEO, GEO and AI Overview optimization</li> </ul> <p><a href="https://www.jhdadvisor.com/contact" style="display:inline-block;background:#7c3aed;color:#fff;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;">Book a JHD Advisor strategy call</a></p> </section>`; return [{ json: { trend, angle, date, title, subtitle, slug, content } }];
